title: Indoor season starts 14 November
text: Six league rounds in the Arsten sports hall. Squad selection depends on the availability page, so send your dates before the next training night.

title: Hall slots confirmed for winter training
text: Tuesday and Thursday evenings are booked in the Arsten hall from 3 November. Bring indoor shoes and your own gloves.

title: Komet finish second in the outdoor table
text: Nine wins from fourteen put the club in a strong spot. A late run chase against Hannover decided the runner-up place.

title: New juniors group starts after the autumn break
text: Open to ages 8 to 14, no experience needed. Soft balls, short boundaries and plenty of batting for everyone.

title: Annual season dinner on 5 December
text: Awards for best batter, best bowler and club person of the year. Names go on the clubhouse board.
